R01.quote: loading `Note` raises `ArgumentError` at `note.rb:10`... `enum :status, { draft: 0, ready: 1 }, prefix: true`
R01.reasons: Validation relies on an unrelated notebooks test and fixture loading; it does not persist draft/ready notes and exercise status filters/helpers after reload.

R02.quote: The positional coder on `serialize :tags` raises too... `serialize coder:` is 7.1+ only, so it ships with the bump.
R02.reasons: Validation only checks fixtures still load; no editing of comma-separated input or checking of the stored representation.

R03.quote: remove `alias_attribute` and define the methods by hand... The edit test posts `highlight_color: "green"` and asserts the checked radio.
R03.reasons: Validation covers edit and inclusion rejection but not reloading JSON settings or preserving existing settings.

R04.quote: `PG::UndefinedColumn: column notes.notebooks does not exist`. Repair: `@notes.where(notebook: @notebook)`
R04.reasons: Named tests plus a foreign-notebook check, but no unequal notebook populations with inclusion/exclusion checks.

R05.quote: the receipt CSV prints blank DOIs. Repair: `citation&.doi`.
R05.reasons: Validation is only an existing CSV test assertion, not a comparison of distinct DOIs with persisted citations.

R06.quote: invalid imports are partly saved. Record counts went from `[0, 3, 0, 1]` to `[1, 4, 1, 2]`... raise ActiveRecord::Rollback unless saved
R06.reasons: Count check for the invalid case only; no successful-batch control and no fresh PostgreSQL verification.

R07.quote: `TypeError: String can't be coerced into Integer`. Repair: `finish(fragments.join)`.
R07.reasons: Validation is the existing export download tests, with no real worker and no exact ordered Markdown bytes or failed-export control.

R08.quote: annotations silently vanish from the import preview. Repair: use `@import.annotations` without `.stringify_keys`.
R08.reasons: Validation is just 'the CSV preview test', with no unequal annotations at lines 2 and 4 and no multiline row.

R10.quote: It is the same instant, but the displayed time differs... `Time.at(reminder_epoch + 86_400).localtime(reminder_at.formatted_offset)`
R10.reasons: Checks the DST-boundary display and stored epoch but has no non-boundary control.

R11.quote: 8.1 serializes `TimeWithZone` with `time_zone`... The digest day and the notes listed change... `requested_at.utc`
R11.reasons: Single-midnight check with the test adapter; no real JSON queue/worker crossing each midnight separately with reservation keys inspected.

R12.quote: a 7.0 worker raises `ActiveJob::DeserializationError` on jobs enqueued by 8.1 processes... A 7.0 payload deserializes fine on 8.1.
R12.reasons: The plan admits it only ran deserialization in a 7.0 process; there is no real producer/consumer matrix with same-version controls and an exact percentage.

R13.quote: `NoMethodError: undefined method 'utc' for an instance of Integer`. Repair: `NoteReminderJob.set(wait_until: Time.at(reminder_epoch))`.
R13.reasons: The reminders test uses the test adapter, not the real scheduled payload/score or persisted schedule time.

R14.quote: `RuntimeError: Couldn't determine a delay based on :exponentially_longer`. Repair: use `:polynomially_longer`. Not available on 7.0
R14.reasons: Impact names only the error, not the loss of bounded retry and the fall-through to Sidekiq retries; validation is one named test without request counts or 503->200/401 controls.

R15.quote: `ActionView::Template::Error: Passed nil to the :model argument`. Repair: drop `model: nil`.
R15.reasons: Validation checks form attributes only, not submission and resulting note membership.

R16.quote: route drawing raises `ArgumentError`... iterates `[notes_path, journal_path]` and must get 200 on both.
R16.reasons: Checks 200 status only, not identical authorized list behavior as owner.

R17.quote: exceptions render as 500 pages, so `assert_raises(ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound)` fails... `:none`. This is 7.1+ only
R17.reasons: Only implied by existing failing tests; no explicit check of raised-exception policy or CI eager-loading modes.

R18.quote: boot fails with `NoMethodError: undefined method '+' for nil`... asserts that `details summary` and `details p` render and that script, `onclick` and `javascript:` hrefs are absent.

R19.reasons: One named test only; no fresh-process special-character credentials, Basic header check or bounded-failure check.

R09.quote: `exports/_export.html.erb:26`: `expires_in` goes negative once an export expires. Use `[export.expires_at - Time.current, 0].max`.
R09.reasons: Impact says the value goes negative but not that rendering raises, including on cache hits; no validation is given.

R20.quote: All of these take effect immediately on the bump, under `load_defaults 7.0`... In 7.1+, `serialize :preferences` without a coder no longer defaults to YAML.
R20.reasons: The plan presents a defaults-gated change as unconditional under retained 7.0 defaults and does not state the missing-coder raise; validation lacks gate off/on testing.

R21.quote: `notebooks_controller.rb:26` permits `:slug`... This raised `ReadonlyAttributeError: slug` on update. Remove `:slug` from `notebook_params`.
R21.reasons: Removing slug from the shared params doesn't address keeping slug assignment on creation; validation is only an existing settings test named elsewhere, without creation or attempted-slug-change checks.

R23.reasons: Points to one test only; no decoding off/on comparison, asymmetric counts, empty report or ownership checks.

R25.reasons: The plan dismisses strict_freshness as needing no action, missing the 200-to-304 change in the export download controller; it names the gate but not the affected code; it asks for no explicit keep/adopt decision and gives no validation.
